name: medi-chat
description: PMDA package inserts search and AI real-time streaming chat system.

scripts.test: pnpm --filter backend test && pnpm --filter data_tools test
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter frontend lint && pnpm --filter backend lint && pnpm --filter data_tools lint
scripts.format: pnpm --filter frontend format && pnpm --filter backend format && pnpm --filter data_tools format
scripts.check: pnpm --filter frontend check && pnpm --filter backend check && pnpm --filter data_tools check
scripts.build:data: pnpm --filter data_tools build-data && pnpm --filter backend build-index
